name: What is the typical process for installing decorative trim work?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for installing decorative trim work?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for installing decorative trim work generally begins with an initial consultation and measurement at your home. Next, we prepare the area, which may involve removing old trim and making any necessary wall repairs. We then cut and fit the new trim pieces, secure them in place, and finish with caulking, sanding, and priming for painting. The timeline can vary based on the complexity and scale of the project, with more intricate designs or larger areas requiring more time for precise installation and finishing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves consultation, measurement, area preparation, cutting/fitting trim, securing, and finishing, with timeline varying by project complexity.
